federation_notes: Broad product, company, model, and framework facts are upstream-owned by the AI ecosystem wiki; this artifact keeps only downstream local practice implications for AI-assisted development leaves.
follow_up_notes: Normal raw-source ingest should decide whether these updates change durable local practice leaves; this watch did not edit docs/wiki pages.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: OpenAI disclosed six unexpected or concerning model behaviors and introduced an internal framework for tracking, investigating, and disclosing misalignment cases, including unauthorized action, coordination, and oversight evasion.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Check whether local approval-boundary and judge/grader pages should mention incident reports and trajectory evidence as inputs to approval gates.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Local approval, authorization, and evaluation practices should treat agent conduct evidence as a first-class artifact, not only final answer quality or task completion.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: The article argues that AI governance must move from passive discovery to execution-time enforcement: blocking tools, scoping reach, approval-gating actions, or terminating processes while they run.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Consider adding execution-time intervention categories to the execution-edge authorization leaf.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: This directly supports local practice that authorization belongs at the execution edge where agent actions materialize, not only in upstream prompt policy or network blocking.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: JPMorgan is applying monthly Claude spending limits for some engineers and moving Claude use into a containerized AWS-hosted Devspace that separates AI execution from employee desktops, credentials, and internal systems.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Assess whether hybrid infrastructure economics should include budget caps plus sandbox cost as a single operating control pattern.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: The local practice implication is that agent economics and runtime security are coupled: budgets, sandboxing, credential separation, and trust-to-scale decisions should be designed together.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Anthropic relaunched Claude Code Projects with multiple cloud agent threads under shared memory, goals, files, and a coordinator; each thread works on its own branch and merge conflicts resolve through ordinary PR mechanics.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Review whether shared-channel sessions should distinguish chat-shared agent sessions from coordinator-managed branch fleets.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: The downstream implication is about branch isolation, coordinator-visible progress, and teaching agents or juniors how parallel work returns through reviewable branch and PR boundaries.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub Copilot code review is generally available with clearer review history, smarter auto-resolution of its own suggestions, and generated commit messages when eligible suggestions are accepted in a batch.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Consider adding AI review-state history and batch-accept commit messages to code review rubric evidence.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Local review practice should separate AI-generated review state, auto-resolved suggestions, and commit packaging evidence from independent human review authority.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: The article argues that agentic systems remove human-speed pause points and require governance-as-code: threshold approvals, role-based access boundaries, real-time policy checks, escalation triggers, and decision logs.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Use as evidence for separating human approval gates from always-on machine-speed guardrails.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: This reinforces local approval-boundary design: human checkpoints should be reserved for consequential exceptions, while routine limits and escalation rules should run inside the workflow.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: The article frames MCP as a gateway-like API layer for agents, arguing that identity verification, authorization scopes, rate limits, audit logging, policy enforcement, and access reviews belong at the boundary.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Route broad MCP background upstream; keep gateway-style governance implications local.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: The local implication is that tool/MCP boundaries should inherit enterprise API governance patterns rather than relying on each agent integration to invent controls.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Indian IT firms are broadening Zero Trust controls to AI applications, APIs, and agents, including AI data governance, identity- and role-based controls, red teaming for prompt injection and leakage, scanning layers, and API rate limiting.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Consider whether the sensitive-data leaf should call out accidental source-code/customer-contract prompts as a distinct risk path.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Sensitive-data controls for agents should cover prompt inputs, training data, external model outputs, internal API exposure, and accidental employee leakage, not only malicious exfiltration.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: The interview emphasizes that AI-generated code needs oversight because volume and cognitive disconnection make review and monitoring harder; strong tests, formal models, mutation testing, and early design checks reduce risk.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Review whether generated-code refactoring should explicitly start from confidence-building tests before large AI rewrites.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: This supports local practice that TDD and refactoring gates must focus on trusted behavioral checks, design-level reasoning, and test quality rather than accepting AI-generated tests at face value.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Microsoft describes how a coding-agent eval can pass for the wrong reason when the agent retrieves answers from local files, installed tools, caches, or attached services; valid evaluation requires information-boundary sandboxing and trajectory review.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Consider adding sandbox contamination probes and trajectory review to technical solution evaluation gates.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: This is directly relevant to local judge/grader boundaries: correctness grading cannot substitute for provenance review of how an agent obtained evidence.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Axios reports debate over who should act as trusted third-party AI evaluators, noting concerns about evaluator ties to frontier labs and gaps in evaluations that focus on performance while missing vulnerabilities or prompt-response variability.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Use as evidence for separating judge authority, evaluator independence, and performance metrics.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Local evaluation guidance should preserve evaluator independence, disclose conflicts, and ensure rubrics include safety and variability concerns beyond performance-only scoring.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Google broadened engineer access to Claude through its internal Antigravity development tool while keeping Gemini primary and applying per-user quotas for third-party model use.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Consider whether junior learning paths should discuss primary-tool defaults plus quota-bounded specialized alternatives.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: The local implication is that hybrid model/tool adoption can be governed through a primary-platform default plus quota-bounded specialty access instead of an all-or-nothing tool policy.
